subject: Principal/Staff Inference — interview slate, bar-raiser focus, and debrief cadence
messages:
From: TalentBridge Recruiting <recruiting@talentbridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate intro: Alex Walker — Principal Inference Engineer (resume + availability)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking a look at Alex Walker. Quick context: Alex is coming off a role at Nebula Analytics where they led model serving and optimization for latency-sensitive pipelines. They meet the "principal" bar on system design and have solid infra + model lifecycle experience.

Attached: candidate-pack-Alex-Walker.pdf (resume + project extract).

Alex's availability for onsite/loop week: Apr 20-22 (pref mornings).

Do you want me to schedule the initial interview loop with the slate below, or should we swap any interviewers? Proposed slate (3.5 hours):
- 45m: System design (serving/runtime) — Markus Klein
- 45m: Model deployment & reliability — Vanessa Ortiz
- 30m: ML infra + data/telemetry — Grace O'Connor
- 30m: Behavioral + leadership — Marissa Cole
- 30m: Bar-raiser deep dive (cross-cut) — Karthik Iyer

Let me know and I'll confirm with Alex.

Cheers,
Sam Lee
TalentBridge Recruiting
recruiting@talentbridge.com

--

Subject: Re: Candidate intro: Alex Walker — Principal Inference Engineer (resume + availability)

Thanks Sam — and hi team,

I've skimmed the packet. Alex's work on runtime optimizations looks relevant. A couple quick asks before I approve the slate:
- Can we make the Bar-raiser slot 45m so Karthik has time to probe cross-cut tradeoffs (cost vs latency, rollout regressions)?
- Markus: please focus system design on multi-tenant routing and graceful fallback paths.
- Grace: allocate a little time for telemetry as a debugging playbook (what signals + how to action).
- Marissa: keep behavioral questions tight, emphasize leadership in ambiguous infra decisions.

Sam: please book the loop for Apr 21, morning if possible. If Alex prefers afternoons, we'll adapt. Keep me posted.

-Vanessa

Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Pre-loop notes: system design prompts + redlines

Team — attaching a short set of prompts I'll use during system design. Highlights:
- Two quick sketches: (1) multi-model routing with cost-based fallbacks, (2) blue/green KV cache invalidation for traffic safety.
- I will include a small whiteboard about stateful vs. stateless inference and ask the candidate to pick a rollback strategy.
- Redlines: if candidate cannot reason about rollback or telemetry-driven rollouts at a system level, flag as a risk for principal scope.

Also: Karthik, if you want to re-order the bar-raiser slot earlier, I can swap my interviewer time.

-Markus
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, TalentBridge Recruiting <recruiting@talentbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-loop debrief plan + immediate asks (Apr 21 loop)

Team — saving the debrief template here so everyone has context ahead of the loop. Please do the following within 24 hours of the interview:
- Enter raw notes into the scorecard (link in calendar invite).
- Each interviewer: give a pass/fail for principal-level expectations and score 1–5 on these axes: System Design, Runtime Tradeoffs, Observability/Telemetry, Leadership & Mentorship, Cross-team Influence.
- Bar-raiser (Karthik): produce a 1-paragraph adjudication focused on risks for scaling and rollout safety.

If the scores are mixed, we'll use the 4pm same-day sync to decide next steps (trial project, second loop, or decline). If unanimous strong pass, Marissa please start offer paperwork.

Key hiring notes for everyone to keep in mind during interviews:
- Principal scope: influence beyond a single product; ownership of inference rollout patterns across customers and tiers.
- Expectation: articulate both cost/latency tradeoffs with quantifiable signals; propose an experiment or rollback plan in the session.
- Bar-raiser focus: evidence of raising quality across teams (not just owning projects).

Thanks — see you on the 21st.

-Vanessa
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
